sections.excerpt:

historical net tangible book value on December 31, 2025 was US$24.6 million, or US$101.2 per Ordinary Share. “Net tangible book
value” is total assets minus the sum of liabilities and intangible assets. “Net tangible book value per share” is net
tangible book value divided by the total number of shares outstanding. Because we have a dual-class share structure, net tangible book
value per share is calculated based on the aggregate number of Class A Ordinary Shares and Class B Ordinary Shares outstanding, being
